thread:
nora: quick heads-up: canary can4-83 (coralv2) after the model-onboard pushed this morning shows p99 ~2.0x vs v3.9 baseline. tagging eng-runtime and ops :warning:

jules: can you paste the run id and what changed in the onboard? any tokenizer or max_seq diffs?

nora: run-id can4-83. onboard diff: tokenizer.max_seq 1024 -> 1800, normalization tweak for wide-char handling. also a tiny kernel-selector tweak in the same PR.

marco: ran lightweight profiler on can4-83, snapshot below:
```
baseline (v3.9): p50 10ms, p95 40ms, p99 90ms, kv_evictions/s 18
canary   (v4.0): p50 12ms, p95 75ms, p99 185ms, kv_evictions/s 410
cpu: decode kernel selection +47% on hot path
stack: frequent kv eviction -> fallback kernel path loops
```

perf-bot: CI perf gate triggered on PR #2980 (model v4.0 onboard) -> p99 regression 2.05x vs baseline.

liz: that's big. can we isolate whether the tokenizer change alone does it or the kernel-selector tweak? propose a bisect: revert tokenizer change locally vs revert kernel selector locally.

marco: started a quick bisect against tags onboard-v3.9..onboard-v4.0. early pointer to commit a1f2b3c (tokenizer normalization + max_seq bump) as first bad. details: tokenization now emits longer prefix segments for many common prompts (avg prefix tokens +42%). KV working set increases dramatically leading to thrashing.

nora: paused the canary rollout and routed traffic back to v3.9. marked the onboard PR as blocked. ops left canary paused.

jules: drafting a revert for the kernel-selector tweak and a safety limiter for tokenizer.max_seq in the runtime. also adding a model-onboard lint that flags max_seq > 1200 to require an explicit perf smoke-run. PR #2992 incoming.

marco: short-term mitigation applied on staging: enabled runtime.kv_cache.prefetch=true and reduced batching.max_window_ms by 15. early effect: p99 reduced to ~1.12x baseline, kv_evictions ~72/s. leaving mitigation on while we iterate.

liz: also adding a targeted CI perf test: simulate mixed short/long prefix workload (50% short <128, 50% long ~1k) assert kv_evictions < 120/s and p99 < 1.3x baseline. will add test to model-onboard pipeline and tag eng-runtime reviewers for any tokenizer config changes.

ops: monitoring dashboards and alerts. canary stays paused until revert + perf test pass. will escalate on paging if kv_evictions > 300/s or p99 spikes >2x. :eyes:

nora: thanks team. I'll attach the bisect log, flamegraphs, and the contrived prompt set that reproduces the long-prefix distribution to the PR. We should also add an observability marker when tokenizer configs change so alerts can be correlated with onboard events.

jules: agreed. adding config-diff annotation in the onboard pipeline and a perf-smoke trigger.

marco: final note from profiler: kernel-selector fallback occurrences increased because the larger KV working set made the preferred high-throughput kernels run out of pinned memory -> we saw repeated reselects which amplified latency. fix options: (1) limit tokenizer.max_seq at onboarding or require mem footprint estimate, (2) improve selector to consider kv footprint and avoid flapping, (3) prefetch/eviction tuning per-model.

nora: we should iterate on 1+2 now. thanks all, will update PR with artifacts and schedule a canary re-run once CI is green.
